candidate_sentence_map.S1: Infortar Group reported a strong 2025 operating performance, although net profit declined because the 2024 result included one-off effects from the initial consolidation of Tallink Grupp.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue increased 33.9% to EUR 1.837 billion from EUR 1.372 billion, while EBITDA rose 60.1% to EUR 232.6 million from EUR 145.4 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The EBITDA margin improved to 13.4% from 10.6%, and operating profit increased 44.2% to EUR 111.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Net profit, however, fell to EUR 72.0 million from EUR 193.7 million, while profit attributable to the parent decreased to EUR 72.7 million from EUR 191.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Earnings per share declined to EUR 3.54 from EUR 9.36.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The report attributes the lower comparative net profit mainly to one-off effects related to Tallink’s initial consolidation in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Revenue was EUR 417.4 million, down 6.4% year-on-year, but EBITDA increased 52.7% to EUR 42.6 million and the EBITDA margin rose to 10.2% from 6.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Operating profit improved from a EUR 6.8 million loss to a EUR 19.8 million profit, while net profit changed from a EUR 12.0 million loss to EUR 14.1 million profit.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Maritime transport revenue increased 2.4% to EUR 188.0 million, EBITDA rose to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 25.7 million, and net profit reached EUR 12.2 million compared with a EUR 5.2 million loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Tallink’s full-year revenue declined 2.6% to EUR 765.3 million, EBITDA fell to EUR 130.1 million from EUR 175.2 million, and passenger volumes decreased 0.9%; cargo units fell 19.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Energy sales volumes increased 7% in the fourth quarter to 4.8 TWh despite a 2% decline in regional gas consumption.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Elenger’s full-year EBITDA improved by approximately EUR 12 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The group also benefited from consolidating Tallink for the full 12 months in 2025, compared with consolidation from August 2024, and from contributions by Estonia Farmid and Halinga.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: The balance sheet strengthened: equity rose to EUR 1.178 billion, the equity ratio improved to 45.5% from 43.0%, and net debt fell to EUR 840.7 million from EUR 1.056 billion, reducing net debt/EBITDA to 3.6 from 4.0.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Operating cash flow increased substantially to EUR 388.6 million from EUR 89.3 million, and year-end cash rose to EUR 219.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Loan and lease liabilities decreased to EUR 1.060 billion from EUR 1.223 billion, reflecting repayments across several Group entities.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Infortar acquired 100% of Oisu Biogaas in the fourth quarter and proposed a dividend consistent with its stated dividend policy.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K6, and K7 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K5 (Real estate segment infrastructure projects) and K8 (Post-reporting events including loan extensions and acquisition of SIA Mood Deco) are MISSING - no mention of Rail Baltica construction, Depo commercial space development, loan maturity extensions, or the February 2026 acquisition of SIA Mood Deco. The summary captures most HIGH-importance financial and operational results but omits two MEDIUM-importance items, resulting in a 'Generally yes' assessment.
